summary: The completed fixed-P1 12-event R1 pilot is internally consistent and its GT labels/tensor correspondences are directly verified. Scope, historical runtime witness limits, bank protocol and future C implementation remain qualified.

nonblocking_findings.title: One-sequence pilot and restricted label support
nonblocking_findings.details: The prefix supports correctness of these 12 write interventions, not full Train coverage or beneficial C learning. Seven zero-delta events at frame >=1200 have current IoU zero and 32 future W/K IoUs both zero; their trajectories nevertheless differ. Positive pilot average does not establish a useful write classifier or long-horizon benefit.

nonblocking_findings.title: Historical runtime witnesses have explicit storage limits
nonblocking_findings.details: Only first K/K, W and K histories are persisted. Saved first-K/K equals saved W/K-K for all 384 record/query/feature rows. The original unsaved second K/K is supported by active assertion + exit-zero evidence, not independent tensor readback. Saved W records independently equal the uninterrupted prefix for 352 available frames (events 0-10); original prefix has no query/feature tensors and stops at event 11 frame 1650. Frozen model/decoder digest comparisons ran but the digest values are not stored. Native/CLIP raw checkpoints, RGB/depth images and the complete external runtime/kernel closure are not in this inventory. These are ceilings on the proof, not evidence of a detected divergent pair or a reason to claim K/K proves uninterrupted-W equivalence.

nonblocking_findings.title: Preserve the measured human-bank protocol exception
nonblocking_findings.details: The same fixed bank/labels as trained P1 are actually used. pine02_wild_320 retains five semicolon clauses in one attribute slot; external parsing splits delimiters and caps at four attributes. The exception is outside this pilot sequence but inside future Train152 scope. It must remain disclosed; silently regenerating the bank would break the fixed-final experiment. Human confirmation is a provenance declaration, not a new reviewer observation.

nonblocking_findings.title: R2 implementation and exact C feature contract are separate prerequisites
nonblocking_findings.details: The current runner intentionally stops at 12 events, and the C input transform/dimension has not been implemented or fixed by this audit. The cache has the current selected feature and native query history, not a separately recorded history of past selected-feature vectors. Future rollout features and GT labels must never become C deployment inputs. R2 needs a source-reviewed full-manifest collector/launcher, complete accounting and a fixed current/past feature contract before launch; this pilot report does not certify that future implementation.

deterministic_acceptance: accepted for actual hash-bound CPU receipts only

A_gt_provenance.details: The actual cube04_indoor dataset groundtruth.txt has 2,576 xywh rows and SHA d32cecf11f9e9bfd15c7bed815ac0208c991df8a7b89c2388219907f6e6b6bb4, exactly the locked training spec. The legal initial box [269,248,33,32] matches row zero and all cached initial boxes. GT is loaded only after K/K, W/K and prediction serialization; it does not select events, crops, candidates, branch controls or reset state. Independent CPU arithmetic recomputed 12 current IoUs and 750 future IoUs on 375 valid future frames with zero disagreement. All 384 future validity flags were checked; 9 invalid frames keep null IoUs. The P1 final, Train spec, human bank and labels match original declared hashes and the prior R0 training-result hash; cached words/masks/empty equal bank row 51. This establishes dataset-GT label provenance for this pilot, not upstream annotation authorship or unseen performance.

B_score_normalization.details: R1 labels use continuous-coordinate xywh intersection divided by geometric union, then the unweighted mean of signed W-minus-K IoUs over that event's valid future GT frames. No max/min/mean of predicted scores is a metric denominator. Decoder probability/native-response ratios, feature normalization and depth-image normalization are inference operations, not label inflation. This custom Train teacher IoU is not the official bounded/raster VOT overlap or DepthTrack long-term P/R/F. All 62 negative per-frame differences and 7 zero event means remain. No event mean is negative in this fixed prefix, so negative-event retention is source-verified but not empirically exercised.

C_result_existence.details: All 121 original files (96,856,148 bytes) were fully read and rehashed, including 24 pilot PTs and physical P1 final. Six supplemental payloads plus four intake/transfer records were read and rehashed. The 47-file snapshot intake, deployment copy, three stage argv/logs/exit files, controller result and original observer/SCP receipts agree. All 58 gate-bound original byte hashes are now directly matched. The primary structure receipt records 57/58 before supplementation; the supplemental receipt closes the R0 all_results gap without rewriting that earlier receipt. Persisted trajectory numbers and tensors were actually loaded on CPU. However the second K/K branch, per-branch live ownership, and before/after frozen state digest values were not separately persisted. The tracker/master still describe R1 as running or results pending; that documentation lags the 11:05:51 +08 completed execution snapshot.

D_called_computations.details: The executed controller launches collect then replay shards 0 and 1. collect calls actor.step, event_from_native_write and pack_event; replay calls legal initialize, unpack_event, K/K, W/K, CPU trajectory serialization, load_truth, valid_gt and iou. The source requires all K/K record/query/selected-feature equality assertions before emitting its true flag, and all stage exits are zero with matching original row logs. Every label function used for R1 has actual serialized outputs independently checked. Imported historical training objectives, official benchmark evaluators and author-reference sanity helpers are not invoked by this pilot. selected_feature is computed/stored but not consumed by FullDenseTracker.step as recurrent state; track_query_before is consumed. z_patch_arr is replaced alongside template slot 1 but is not a prediction input in the audited FullDenseTracker path. No utility head or C optimizer is called or implemented here; no C benefit can be inferred from the feature cache.

E_scope.details: Exactly one fixed P1 third-pass final, seed 2027, human-text condition, one collection prefix of cube04_indoor (manifest sequence index 0), 1,650 tracking steps, and 12 first actual native-rule writes at frames 250,300,550,700,750,1200,1300,1450,1500,1550,1600,1650. This is 1/152 sequences and 1,650/219,802=0.7506756% of full Train tracking calls, with even that one sequence only partially traversed. Each event has 32 future frames, for 384 frame locations and 1,536 executed future tracking steps across K/K and W/K. Three histories per event are stored (1,152 rows); four were executed. All 12 current GT boxes are valid; 9 future frame labels are unknown; all 12 events meet common eligibility. Event means are 5 positive, 7 zero, 0 negative, 0 unknown. No negative-event mean, invalid-current event, empty-valid-future window or sequence-tail truncated window was observed. No full Train teacher, C fitting, multi-seed robustness or new benchmark result is present.

F_evaluation_type.details: Current IoU, future W/K IoU and mean delta are real_gt Train-only diagnostic teacher labels, conditional on model-selected native write events. K/K equality and saved-W versus native-prefix equality are self_supervised_proxy execution consistency checks, not ground-truth tracking accuracy. Human initialization text is a fixed human-provided input, not human evaluation of predictions. Decoder quality and observation values are learned proxies (localization and observed-window intersection), not physical-identity or phrase-visibility truth. There is no synthetic-proxy GT masquerading as dataset truth, no simulated experiment here, and no new official benchmark evaluation.

claims.claim: Exactly the frozen 12-event pilot completed, with own-history current/past inference, same-GPU forks, correct GT-derived labels and exact stored repeated-K trajectories.
352 available original-prefix W records match exactly; no original feature/query tensor equivalence or event-11 uninterrupted continuation is demonstrated.
Full Train152 fixed-final teacher coverage has not been collected by this pilot.
No C optimization, current-versus-future supervision comparison, robust write benefit or new benchmark improvement has been demonstrated.
The overall research target remains unmet; the gate-bound R0 aggregate explicitly has any_joint_pass=false.

prerequisites_before_R2.requirement: Implement and source-audit the complete fixed-P1 Train152 collector/launcher with the exact existing spec/final/bank/labels, 152 sequences and 219802 source tracking calls; the 12-event runner is not the full collector.

Fix the identical current/past feature transform, ordering, dimensions, dtypes and eligibility for C-current and C-future before teacher collection/fit. Do not read future rollout tensors or GT labels in deployment features; explicitly collect any required past selected-feature history.

Retain full event accounting, including negative/zero/unknown labels and all excluded eligibility cases, plus same-GPU W/K branch controls, state/source/final/bank bindings and completed raw label outputs.

Budget the new full collector using measured byte/call costs and actual available storage; declare whether full collection repeats K/K or only W/K. Do not reuse the one-sequence event rate as an observed full-Train count. Keep the immutable R1 snapshot and the disclosed bank exception.
